title: COMMUNICATION FROM COMMUNITY INVESTMENT DEPARTMENT (CID) relative to the terminations of Temporary Protected Status (TPS) and City response.
text:
[Council File 26-1172]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
COMMUNICATION FROM COMMUNITY INVESTMENT DEPARTMENT (CID) relative to the terminations of Temporary Protected Status (TPS) and City response.
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. INSTRUCT the CID to redesign the Day Labor Resource Centers to expand scope of services and provide authority to release a Request for Proposal that includes expanded services.
2. INSTRUCT the City Administrative Officer (CAO) report on funding options for the RepresentLA program for focused response to support communities impacted by TPS termination.
3. INSTRUCT the Community Investment Department (CID) continues and expands public awareness of Know Your Rights information and resources tailored to impacted populations, including TPS holders, their families, and their employers.
4. AUTHORIZE the General Manager of CID, or designee, to make any technical adjustments that may be required to implement the recommendations.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
(Civil Rights, Immigration, Social Services, and Neighborhoods Committee waived consideration of the above matter.)
